summary: When upgrading from 2.4 to 2.6, controller and hub roles are renamed to platform-wide roles (e.g. controller auditor to Platform auditor, org admin to Organization Administrator, hub administrator to Team member), user types are mapped and same-named hub team memberships merge into gateway teams.
questions: What do 2.4 controller roles become in AAP 2.6?
What happens to the automation hub administrator role after upgrading to 2.6?
Are team memberships kept when upgrading from 2.4 to 2.6?
Is the controller auditor role still available in 2.6?

answer_card.title: 2.4 roles mapped to 2.6
answer_card.answer_md:
| 2.4 role | 2.6 equivalent |
|---|---|
| Controller auditor | Platform auditor |
| Controller superuser (flag) | Platform superuser (flag) |
| Controller organization admin | Organization Administrator |
| Controller organization member | Organization member |
| Controller team admin | Team administrator |
| Automation hub administrator | Team member (user) |
| Controller/hub team member | Team member (user) |

Same-named teams in hub and gateway get hub memberships transferred.
